quarterly_data.quarter: East Tender Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management: in 1H25 customers paused pull-ins on US tariff uncertainty and telecom inventory adjustment; customers resumed pull-ins in 2H25, especially for access-network demand in China and the US. Drivers named: AI shifting from training to inference lifting communications-infrastructure demand, infrastructure tenders reviving telecom applications, and deeper cooperation with existing customers. FY2025 revenue mix: filters NT$130,398 thousand (75.29%), IoT products NT$42,804 thousand (24.71%, subsidiary Milos trading); exports to China 62.22% and Hong Kong 19.00% of revenue. Customer A (unnamed) took NT$36,202 thousand, 20.90% of revenue, as it strengthened new-product development with the company.

quarterly_data.quarter: East Tender Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 outlook (management): with telecom demand stabilising and access-network build-outs continuing, existing optical-communications shipments are expected to stay stable; new product lines - high-end datacom filters, biomedical filters, high-energy laser optics, optical module devices and semiconductor coating - are expected to ramp gradually in 2026; losses are expected to keep narrowing toward breakeven. 2026 planned sales of coated components: 6,633 thousand pieces (planned production / purchase 9,383 thousand pieces).
quarterly_data.figure: coated components planned sales 6,633 thousand pieces

quarterly_data.quarter: East Tender Optoelectronics annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Technology: the company worked with customers to develop 400G and 800G transmission modules, 25G PON and 50G PON applications (1260-1680nm band). Strategy: focus on high-speed networking, AI data centers and biomedical testing - R&D on filters for 800G / 1.6T optical modules, high-energy laser optics and biomedical multi-band filters, extending into satellite communications and CPO/LPO. Short-term development: high-end filters for compact cloud data-center transmission modules and AI data-center transmission filters; mid/long-term: 6G filters, semiconductor coating foundry services, CPO/LPO components.
